@section l35-08 | Unit 8 | Vocabulary practice · Unit 8 | 文意字彙・選擇題・配合題
@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: We can't afford a vacation this year because we're really t______t on money right now.
= tight
~詞義 tight（adj.）吃緊的
~原文 We can't afford a vacation this year because we're really tight on money right now.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Most people r______y on electronic devices such as computers and smartphones to get the information they need.
= rely
~詞義 rely（v.）依賴
~原文 Most people rely on electronic devices such as computers and smartphones to get the information they need.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: R______r has it that Alexander is the real father of the baby boy.
= rumor
~詞義 rumor（n.）謠言
~原文 Rumor has it that Alexander is the real father of the baby boy.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: If you want to attend the meeting, you have to get official ______ (permit) from the administration.
= permission
~詞義 permission（n.）許可;准許
~原文 If you want to attend the meeting, you have to get official permission from the administration.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The smell in this room is ______ (bare) tolerable. Would you mind if I opened the window?
= barely
~詞義 barely（adv.）幾乎不
~原文 The smell in this room is barely tolerable. Would you mind if I opened the window?

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The new water tank has a much larger ______ and can hold twice as much as the old one.
A: advantage
B: substance
C: material
D: volume
= D
~詞義 volume（n.）容量
~原文 The new water tank has a much larger volume and can hold twice as much as the old one.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The bush fires have caused ______ damage to Australia.
A: inferior
B: superior
C: reliable
D: considerable
= D
~詞義 considerable（adj.）相當多的
~原文 The bush fires have caused considerable damage to Australia.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Annie ______ from the idea of giving a speech in public, fearing she would make mistakes.
A: tightened
B: subtracted
C: permitted
D: shrank
= D
~詞義 shrink（v.）畏縮;逃避
~原文 Annie shrank from the idea of giving a speech in public, fearing she would make mistakes.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: This bridge is a great work of engineering and construction, and it helps people who live in ______ areas get to the city quickly.
A: fancy
B: wealthy
C: remote
D: superior
= C
~詞義 remote（adj.）偏遠的
~原文 This bridge is a great work of engineering and construction, and it helps people who live in remote areas get to the city quickly.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: After getting an invitation to the Halloween party, Kevin decided to dress up as a Roman ______.
A: tumor
B: emperor
C: vehicle
D: supervisor
= B
~詞義 emperor（n.）皇帝
~原文 After getting an invitation to the Halloween party, Kevin decided to dress up as a Roman emperor.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: screaming
B: bare
C: fancy
D: thread
E: patience
F: electricity

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: A kindergarten teacher should have a fun personality, a kind heart, and ______.
= E
~詞義 patience（n.）耐心
~原文 A kindergarten teacher should have a fun personality, a kind heart, and patience.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The nurse asked the patient to ______ his arm so that she could give the injection.
= B
~詞義 bare（v.）露出
~原文 The nurse asked the patient to bare his arm so that she could give the injection.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: My brother disconnected the machine from the ______ supply before trying to fix it.
= F
~詞義 electricity（n.）電
~原文 My brother disconnected the machine from the electricity supply before trying to fix it.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The actress didn't want to wear something too ______, but rather a simple white dress.
= C
~詞義 fancy（adj.）花俏的
~原文 The actress didn't want to wear something too fancy, but rather a simple white dress.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Running away or ______ in horror is the reaction of many people when they see big spiders or cockroaches.
= A
~詞義 screaming（v.）尖叫
~原文 Running away or screaming in horror is the reaction of many people when they see big spiders or cockroaches.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: media
B: victims
C: union
D: vehicles
E: tapped
F: scattered

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Up to 85% of the employees don't support the ______ of the two technology enterprises.
= C
~詞義 union（n.）結合;合併
~原文 Up to 85% of the employees don't support the union of the two technology enterprises.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Shortly after the eight-car train traveling to Taitung came off the tracks inside a tunnel, the authorities made a rough calculation of the number of ______.
= B
~詞義 victims（n.）受害者
~原文 Shortly after the eight-car train traveling to Taitung came off the tracks inside a tunnel, the authorities made a rough calculation of the number of victims.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The baker ______ some cocoa powder on top of the birthday cake.
= F
~詞義 scattered（v.）撤
~原文 The baker scattered some cocoa powder on top of the birthday cake.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: In his speech, he emphasized the negative impacts of social ______, including gossip and false information.
= A
~詞義 media（n.）媒體
~原文 In his speech, he emphasized the negative impacts of social media, including gossip and false information.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The latest figures show that there are too many ______ in Taiwan, leading to frequent traffic jams.
= D
~詞義 vehicles（n.）車輛
~原文 The latest figures show that there are too many vehicles in Taiwan, leading to frequent traffic jams.
